title: An invariant geometric germ has a section over its finite separable field
statement: Let $K\subset K_s\subset\Omega$ be a compatible field tower [def-pc-field-extension], with $K_s$ a separable closure of $K$ [def-kun-separably-closed] and $\Omega$ algebraically closed and algebraic over $K$. Let $s=\operatorname{Spec}(K\to\Omega)$ be the geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on $(\operatorname{Spec}K)_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with geometric stalk $M$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Suppose a left action $a$ of $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K_s/K)$ on $M$ satisfies $a(g,[X,x,z])=[X,\operatorname{Spec}(\tau)\mathbin{;}x,z]$ whenever $\tau\in\operatorname{Aut}_K(\Omega)$ extends $g$. Let $L\subset K_s$ be a finite separable intermediate extension, and let $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}L$ be the specified lift induced by $L\hookrightarrow K_s\hookrightarrow\Omega$. For every $m\in M$ fixed by $H_L=\operatorname{Gal}(K_s/L)$, there exists $z\in F(\operatorname{Spec}L)$ with germ $[\operatorname{Spec}L,x,z]=m$.

source.place: Tags 03QW and 04JM; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QW and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04JM

proof.text: Apply exists_finiteGalois_germ_representative to obtain a finite Galois E containing L, its canonical geometric lift y, and a section z with germ m.

Equality of two germs over Spec E holds on a common pointed refinement. This refinement is nonempty and its map to the one-point Spec E is a singleton etale cover. The separated sheaf condition makes restriction injective.

Rewrite the fixed-germ condition using germ(z)=m and apply exists_fieldSection_of_finiteGalois_invariant_representative with the injectivity just established. It returns a section w over L with germ(w)=germ(z); transitivity gives germ(w)=m.

proof_origin.place: Tag 04JM direct proof, lemma-global-sections-point. Q2 records the unchanged upstream proof after retirement of the Sheaf twin; the smaller-universe consumer is bridged via ULift.

theorem exists_fieldSection_of_invariant_germ
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    (hs : s = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))
    (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) v)))
    (action : MulAction Gal(Ks/K) ((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj F))
    (haction : ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω),
      (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
        τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω) →
      ∀ (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) (x x' : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj X),
      x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left →
      ∀ (z : F.obj.obj (op X)),
      action.smul g ((pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber X x F.obj z) =
        (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber X x' F.obj z)
    (L : IntermediateField K Ks) [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    (x : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj (etaleSpec K L))
    (hx : x.left = Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom ((algebraMap Ks Ω).comp L.subtype)))
    (m : (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj F)
    (hm : ∀ g ∈ L.fixingSubgroup, action.smul g m = m) :
    ∃ z : F.obj.obj (op (etaleSpec K L)),
      (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber (etaleSpec K L) x F.obj z = m
